title: Hull offsets table (tpt-yard stability)
description: Frictionless Table Schema for the offsets CSV read by `parse_offsets_csv`. One row per offset. Comma, semicolon or tab separated; `#` starts a comment; one optional header row; rows in any order. Each station (same station_x_m) must start at the baseline (draft_m = 0), must not repeat a draft, and needs at least two offsets; at least two stations are required. The hull is taken as symmetric about the centreline, so only the half-breadth is given.

fields.name: station_x_m
fields.description: Longitudinal position from midship, metres, positive forward.

fields.name: half_breadth_m
fields.description: Half-breadth of the section at that height, metres.
